narrative.intro: TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligated $900M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date across 3 awards, with an average award size of $300M and year-over-year obligations down 94.6%. TriWest obligations concentrate in Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers, which accounted for $900M of FY2027 to-date obligations. Fiscal-year trends show TriWest obligations were $7.4B in FY22, $8B in FY23, $8.4B in FY24, $13.4B in FY25, $16.6B in FY26, and $900M in FY27 to date. Current-year totals are partial because FY2027 is not complete. The firm recorded $0 in Pharmacy Benefit Management and Other Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds during FY2027 to date. Award counts and average award sizes reflect obligated amounts rather than total contract ceilings. Readers should use the FY2027 to-date figures as a snapshot of ongoing activity rather than a full-year total. The available data show a sharp year-over-year drop in obligations during the current fiscal year to date compared with the prior fiscal year totals.
